title: What to order at McDonald's when you want to lose weight
intro: Sometimes life gets busy and McDonald's is the nearest option. That's okay. You can still order smart. The key is size, sets and drinks. The calories below are estimates.

best.name: McD Chicken Porridge (Bubur Ayam McD)
best.why: Light and warm. Good for breakfast or when you don't feel like a heavy meal.

best.name: Hamburger
best.why: Small size, enough to stop the hunger and still tasty.

best.name: Filet-O-Fish
best.why: One of the lower-calorie burgers. Moderate size.

best.name: Chicken McNuggets, 6 pieces
best.why: Protein in a controlled portion. Pick a lighter sauce like chilli sauce.

best.name: McD Fried Chicken, 1 piece (skin removed)
best.why: The chicken meat is high in protein. Removing the skin saves a lot of calories.

best.name: McChicken
best.why: Filling for lunch. Pair it with plain water, not a large set.

careful.name: Big Mac
careful.why: Two layers of meat plus sauce. Okay once in a while, but heavier than a regular burger.

careful.name: Spicy Chicken McDeluxe
careful.why: Battered chicken with mayonnaise sauce. High calories in one burger.

careful.name: Large fries
careful.why: Easy to finish without noticing. A small size or sharing makes more sense.

careful.name: McFlurry
careful.why: High in sugar. If you want dessert, try a smaller ice cream cone.

careful.name: Large set with regular soft drink
careful.why: The sweet drink and large fries double your burger's calories.

hacks: Order ala carte, not a set. Or ask for the set with mineral water.
If you want fries, get a small size or share.
Ask for 'kurang sos' (less sauce) or 'tak mau mayonis' (no mayo) for chicken burgers.
For fried chicken, pick the breast part and remove the skin.
Add a corn cup as a side instead of fries.
drink: Mineral water. If you want a hot drink, go for coffee or tea without sugar.

faq.q: Can I eat McDonald's while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes, if you pick small sizes, avoid sweet drinks and don't make it a daily habit. One burger with mineral water can fit into your daily calories.

faq.q: My kids want McDonald's. How should I order?
faq.a: Try a Filet-O-Fish or 6 McNuggets with a corn cup and mineral water. You still eat together with the family without feeling too heavy.
